lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਮ ਵੇਦੁ ਰਿਗੁ ਜੁਜਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saam ved rig jujar atharaban ||
lines.translation: The Saam Veda, the Rig Veda, the Jujar Veda and the At'harva Veda

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahame mukh maaiaa hai trai gun ||
lines.translation: form the mouth of Brahma; they speak of the three gunas, the three qualities of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਤਿਉ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਿਉ ਬੋਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat kahi na sakai ko tiu bole jiu bolaaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: None of them can describe His worth. We speak as He inspires us to speak. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਸਪਤ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nahu sapat paataal upaae ||
lines.translation: From the Primal Void, He created the seven nether regions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਭਵਣ ਰਖੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nahu bhavan rakhe liv laae ||
lines.translation: From the Primal Void, He established this world to lovingly dwell upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: aape kaaran keeaa apara(n)par sabh tero keeaa kamaaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: The Infinite Lord Himself created the creation. Everyone acts as You make them act, Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਜ ਤਮ ਸਤ ਕਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raj tam sat kal teree chhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Your Power is diffused through the three gunas: raajas, taamas and satva.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran haumai dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through egotism, they suffer the pains of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਚਉਥੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare har guramukh gun chauthai mukat karaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: Those blessed by His Grace become Gurmukh; they attain the fourth state, and are liberated. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਉਪਜੇ ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nahu upaje das avataaraa ||
lines.translation: From the Primal Void, the ten incarnations welled up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: srisat upaai keeaa paasaaraa ||
lines.translation: Creating the Universe, He made the expanse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: dev daanav gan ga(n)dharab saaje sabh likhiaa karam kamaaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: He fashioned the demi-gods and demons, the heavenly heralds and celestial musicians; everyone acts according to their past karma. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh samajhai rog na hoee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh understands, and does not suffer the disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih gur kee pauRee jaanai jan koee ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who understand this ladder of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਾਇਣ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jugah juga(n)tar mukat paraain so mukat bhaiaa pat paaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: Throughout the ages, they are dedicated to liberation, and so they become liberated; thus they are honored. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਸੁੰਨਹੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch tat su(n)nahu paragaasaa ||
lines.translation: From the Primal Void, the five elements became manifest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਕਰਮ ਅਭਿਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: deh sa(n)jogee karam abhiaasaa ||
lines.translation: They joined to form the body, which engages in actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੀਖੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬੀਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa dui masatak leekhe paap pu(n)n beejaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: Both bad and good are written on the forehead, the seeds of vice and virtue. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam satigur purakh niraale ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is sublime and detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate har ras matavaale ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, He is intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ridh budh sidh giaan guroo te paaeeai poorai bhaag milaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: Riches, intellect, miraculous spiritual powers and spiritual wisdom are obtained from the Guru; through perfect destiny, they are received. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is man maaiaa kau nehu ghaneraa ||
lines.translation: This mind is so in love with Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee boojhahu giaanee karahu niberaa ||
lines.translation: Only a few are spiritually wise enough to understand and know this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਰੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa manasaa haumai sahasaa nar lobhee kooR kamaaidaa ||16||
lines.translation: In hope and desire, egotism and skepticism, the greedy man acts falsely. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te paae veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: From the True Guru, contemplative meditation is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਚੇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)n samaadh sache ghar baaraa ||
lines.translation: And then, one dwells with the True Lord in His celestial home, the Primal State of Absorption in Deepest Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੭॥੫॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak niramal naad sabad dhun sach raamai naam samaaidaa ||17||5||17||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the immaculate sound current of the Naad, and the Music of the Shabad resound; one merges into the True Name of the Lord. ||17||5||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai na jaaee prabh kirapaalaa ||
lines.translation: God is compassionate; He does not come or go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeeaa a(n)dar jugat samaaee rahio niraalam raaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: He pervades all beings in His mysterious way; the Sovereign Lord remains detached. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag tis kee chhaaiaa jis baap na maaiaa ||
lines.translation: The world is a reflection of Him; He has no father or mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੈਣ ਨ ਭਰਾਉ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis bhain na bharaau kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has not acquired any sister or brother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਓਪਤਿ ਖਪਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਜਾਤੀ ਓਹੁ ਅਜਰਾਵਰੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis opat khapat kul jaatee ohu ajaraavar man bhaaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: There is no creation or destruction for Him; He has no ancestry or social status. The Ageless Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too akaal purakh naahee sir kaalaa ||
lines.translation: You are the Deathless Primal Being. Death does not hover over Your head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਗੰਮ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too purakh alekh aga(n)m niraalaa ||
lines.translation: You are the unseen inaccessible and detached Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sat sa(n)tokh sabad at seetal sahaj bhaai liv laaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: You are true and content; the Word of Your Shabad is cool and soothing. Through it, we are lovingly, intuitively attuned to You. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਚਉਥੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai varataai chauthai ghar vaasaa ||
lines.translation: The three qualities are pervasive; the Lord dwells in His home, the fourth state.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਕੀਏ ਇਕ ਗ੍ਰਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal bikaal keee ik graasaa ||
lines.translation: He has made death and birth into a bite of food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰਬ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: niramal jot sarab jagajeevan gur anahad sabad dikhaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: The immaculate Light is the Life of the whole world. The Guru reveals the unstruck melody of the Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਤਮ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ootam jan sa(n)t bhale har piaare ||
lines.translation: Sublime and good are those humble Saints, the Beloveds of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras maate paar utaare ||
lines.translation: They are intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and are carried across to the other side.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੇਣ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ren sa(n)t jan sa(n)gat har gur parasaadee paaiaa ||5||
lines.translation: Nanak is the dust of the Society of the Saints; by Guru's Grace, he finds the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee jee sabh tere ||
lines.translation: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. All beings belong to You.
